name: seuif97
description: The WebAssembly implementation of the high-speed IAPWS-IF97 package SEUIF97 in Rust

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/seuif97.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web
